# tcpshield_user_profile (Resource)

The general info (name, phone) of the account the API key belongs to. A singleton: creating it adopts the account, destroying it only removes it from state. The API takes all three fields on every update and rejects an empty one (`PhoneNumber is a required field`) — so all three are required, and a phone number, once set, cannot be removed again through the API. Email, password and API key are deliberately not managed — see the provider README.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The API requires all three fields on every update and refuses an empty one.
resource "tcpshield_user_profile" "me" {
  firstname = "Ada"
  lastname  = "Lovelace"
  phone     = "+44 20 7946 0000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `phone` (String) Phone number.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric user id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The account is a singleton; any id works.
tofu import tcpshield_user_profile.me me
```
